verzen.tekst: Save me, God,
verzen.html: Save me, God,

verzen.tekst: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold.
verzen.html: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold.

verzen.tekst: I am weary with my crying.
verzen.html: I am weary with my crying.

verzen.tekst: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head.
verzen.html: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head.

verzen.tekst: God, you know my foolishness.
verzen.html: God, you know my foolishness.

verzen.tekst: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies.
verzen.html: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies.

verzen.tekst: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach.
verzen.html: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach.

verzen.tekst: I have become a stranger to my brothers,
verzen.html: I have become a stranger to my brothers,

verzen.tekst: For the zeal of your house consumes me.
verzen.html: For the zeal of your house consumes me.

verzen.tekst: When I wept and I fasted,

verzen.tekst: When I made sackcloth my clothing,
verzen.html: When I made sackcloth my clothing,

verzen.tekst: Those who sit in the gate talk about me.
verzen.html: Those who sit in the gate talk about me.

verzen.tekst: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time.
verzen.html: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time.

verzen.tekst: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink.
verzen.html: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink.

verzen.tekst: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me,
verzen.html: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me,

verzen.tekst: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good.
verzen.html: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good.

verzen.tekst: Don’t hide your face from your servant,
verzen.html: Don’t hide your face from your servant,

verzen.tekst: Draw near to my soul and redeem it.
verzen.html: Draw near to my soul and redeem it.

verzen.tekst: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonour.
verzen.html: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonour.

verzen.tekst: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness.
verzen.html: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness.

verzen.tekst: They also gave me poison for my food.
verzen.html: They also gave me poison for my food.

verzen.tekst: Let their table before them become a snare.
verzen.html: Let their table before them become a snare.

verzen.tekst: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see.
verzen.html: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see.

verzen.tekst: Pour out your indignation on them.
verzen.html: Pour out your indignation on them.

verzen.tekst: Let their habitation be desolate.
verzen.html: Let their habitation be desolate.

verzen.tekst: For they persecute him whom you have wounded.

verzen.tekst: Charge them with crime upon crime.
verzen.html: Charge them with crime upon crime.

verzen.tekst: Let them be blotted out of the book of life,
verzen.html: Let them be blotted out of the book of life,

verzen.tekst: But I am in pain and distress.
verzen.html: But I am in pain and distress.

verzen.tekst: I will praise the name of God with a song,
verzen.html: I will praise the name of God with a song,

verzen.tekst: It will please the LORD better than an ox,
verzen.html: It will please the LORD better than an ox,

verzen.tekst: The humble have seen it, and are glad.
verzen.html: The humble have seen it, and are glad.

verzen.tekst: For the LORD hears the needy,
verzen.html: For the LORD hears the needy,

verzen.tekst: Let heaven and earth praise him;
verzen.html: Let heaven and earth praise him;

verzen.tekst: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah.
